catalog: Existing prices and unlock rules in GenericCatalog.json; unchanged

presentation.inspector: Opaque Upgrade-style card with ownership/state, balance and price, red exact MISSING amount, next required objective and actionable button. Paid card labels show price; achievement cards show CAREER REWARD.
presentation.confirmation: Existing serialized Confirmation panel with dedicated authored Livery Details group, the same native surfaces, yellow unmet requirements and red controller selection. Paid purchase initially focuses Back.
presentation.requirements: MET/NEEDED per medal. Nova Purple shows all six Gold targets and routes to the next unmet event.
presentation.paid: Both medal and credit blockers remain visible. Partial balance shows exact missing credits; exact balance enables Buy and equip with price.
presentation.rewards: Career rewards are free, never show a credit shortfall, and may be claimed if requirements were already completed but ownership was not yet granted. Existing automatic race-result grants are retained.
presentation.equipped: Owned liveries equip for free. Preview does not mutate progress or physics.
presentation.navigation: Virtual gamepad Submit opens the prerequisite and Cancel restores the same livery preview and source action. Card up/down and left/right navigation remains inside the active Garage section.

validation.scope: Unity Editor Play Mode with isolated temporary save and virtual gamepad; no target-platform build or physical-controller validation.
